required.label: What {status} needs
required.blocks_one: Cannot move to {status} yet: {count} document missing
required.blocks_other: Cannot move to {status} yet: {count} documents missing
required.warns_one: Before {status}: {count} document to add (it does not block)
required.warns_other: Before {status}: {count} documents to add (they do not block)
required.how: Upload the document here (or on the supplier), then say what it is and until when with "What it is".
required.partyDocuments: Also counted, from the record's customer or supplier: {names}
required.unreadable: What this record needs before its next steps could not be read.

versions.title: Versions of {name}
versions.intro: Every version is kept, read-only. Restore makes a new version from an earlier one; tick two pictures to see them side by side.
versions.pickNamed: Pick version {n} for side by side
versions.bySystem: Nexus (a copy or a document it made)

held.current: This version is already in force.
held.notAvailable: This version is not available (still uploading, held or refused).
held.uploading: A new version is still uploading: confirm it or give it up first.
held.pickTwo: Tick two versions to see them side by side.
held.pictures: Side by side shows two pictures; a PDF opens on its own.

tag.title: What {name} is
tag.intro: Say what this document is and the last day it is valid. Nexus reminds 30 and 7 days before; a document shared with the partner asks the partner for a new version.
tag.categoryHint: A required-document rule counts only documents of its kind.
tag.expiresHint: Leave it empty when the document does not expire. A new date starts the reminders again.

problem.date: The date is not a valid date, or more than 20 years away.
problem.category: Pick a kind from the list.

markup.title: Mark up {name}
markup.introPicture: Draw arrows and circles on the picture. Saved, the marked picture becomes the next version; the original stays, read-only.
markup.introPdf: Draw arrows and circles on a page. The marks are kept beside the PDF; the PDF itself never changes.
markup.savePdf: Keep the marks on this page

held.noMarks: Draw at least one arrow or circle first.

notice.restored: The earlier version is back as a new version.
notice.tagged: Saved: what the document is and until when.
notice.marked: The marked picture is the new version; the original stays, read-only.
notice.overlay: The marks are kept on this page.

held.noUpload: You need the right to upload files on this record.
held.notMarkable: Only a picture (JPEG, PNG, WebP) or a PDF can be marked up.
held.notCurrent: An earlier version is read-only: use the version in force.
held.unreadable: This record's documents could not be read: try again above.

problem.store: The file store did not answer: try again in a moment.
problem.failed: That did not work: try again.
problem.conflict: Someone changed this file meanwhile: it was read again; check and try again.
problem.forbidden: You may not do this on this record.
problem.notFound: This file is no longer there.
problem.invalid: Nexus did not accept this: check what was drawn or typed.
problem.unavailable: Nexus is not reachable right now: try again in a moment.
